title: Collision Repair Authorization Form
subtitle: Collision Repair: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Collision Repair Authorization Form turns damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need into a customer-facing Collision Repair consent record. The collision repair coordinator itemizes diagnostics or services, labor, parts or materials, fees, tax, estimated total, maximum cap, and the vehicle owner / insurer contact's signed decision. Work not listed or priced remains on hold.
use_case: Use Collision Repair Authorization Form at intake area, body bay, frame or measurement area, refinish area, and delivery point. Verify applicable Collision Repair requirements; distinguish diagnostic or inspection authority from listed work, price each operation, and record the vehicle owner / insurer contact's exact approval, conditions, or decline. Follow the selected contact-before-additional-work instruction whenever damaged vehicle area, structural or restraint concern, repair plan, supplement, refinish operation, and calibration need scope or cost changes.
